FAQ

How do I set a wallpaper?

Open a wallpaper, tap Set wallpaper and choose home screen, lock screen or both. Setting a wallpaper never shows an ad.

How do I change what part of the picture shows?

Tap position, drag the picture inside the frame, then confirm. The same crop is used on the screen you choose.

How do I save a wallpaper to my gallery?

Tap save. You can watch one optional ad first; if no ad is available the save goes ahead anyway. Saved pictures go to Pictures/Hushwalls. Remove ads skips the ad step.

I bought Remove ads on another phone.

Open Settings, tap Restore purchase, using the same Google account you bought with.

A wallpaper looks wrong or should not be here.

Open it and tap report. Your email app opens with the details filled in; you press send. Or email us the wallpaper's title.

Where are my picks?

In the Saved tab. They stay on your phone and work offline.

How do I free up space?

Settings, then clear the image cache.

How do I change my ad choice?

Settings, Ad privacy options, where Google's rules require that option.

How do I delete my data?

See the delete your data page; the app keeps nothing on our servers.
